Name: NPCEscort
Description:
Requires Lv. 1

Interact with the Elder and safely escort them to the destination. The NPC will stop moving if they are too far away from you or if monsters get too close.

Name: Maze
Description:
Requires Lv. 10

Defeat every monster lurking within the maze to clear the dungeon.

Name: Defence
Description:
Requires Lv. 20

Interact with the Nun at the center of the map. Protect her from the endless waves of monsters.

Name: BossRaid
Description:
Requires Lv. 40

Interact with the NPC to challenge the boss. Defeat the boss, who occasionally unleashes powerful special attacks, and protect the village.

Name: Village
Description: A peaceful village where adventurers gather. Visit the Blacksmith to enhance your equipment, buy supplies from the Shop, and prepare for your next adventure.
